title: Do senators and house members beat the stock market? Evidence ...
snippet: Mar 1, 2022 · Using a novel dataset of the financial transactions of United States Senators and House Members, we calculate short and medium run buy and hold abnormal returns for the publicly-listed securities that these officials buy and sell. We find no evidence of stock picking prowess.

title: BSc Thesis Gao & Åhlqvist
snippet: In this thesis, our aim was to investigate whether members of the U.S. Congress earned abnormal returns on their stock trades, and to identify specific conditions under which such returns may occur.
